UserActivityProfile.title: UserActivityProfile
UserActivityProfile.description: Per-user activity dashboard document showing which user is active, total requests raised, Firebase vs Cloudflare breakdown, average solve latency, and cumulative active time in seconds. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt, updatedAt, and lastActiveAt.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In (0..120 characters).

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In (0..254 characters).

appVersion.description: App version string such as '3.5.2' (1..32 characters).

totalRequests.description: Total solve requests raised by this user.

firebaseRequests.description: Requests answered via Firebase AI Logic.

cloudflareRequests.description: Requests answered via Cloudflare Workers AI.

cacheHits.description: Requests served instantly from local or shared cache.

failedRequests.description: Requests that ended in an error or timeout.

totalLatencyMs.description: Cumulative solve latency in milliseconds across completed requests.

avgLatencyMs.description: Running average solve latency in milliseconds.

totalActiveSeconds.description: Cumulative active app + Dynamic Island overlay time in seconds.

lastFeatureUsed.description: Most recent feature used by the user.

lastBackendUsed.description: Most recent backend that handled a request.

lastActiveAt.description: Most recent activity timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

createdAt.description: Immutable account telemetry creation timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserRequestLog.title: UserRequestLog
UserRequestLog.description: Immutable per-request audit entry showing which user raised a solve request, which feature and backend handled it, model name, latency, and result badge. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the requesting user.

userEmail.description: Email of the requesting user for Firebase Console visibility (0..254 characters).

feature.description: App feature that initiated the solve request.

backend.description: Backend engine that fulfilled or failed the request.

modelUsed.description: Model identifier or provider label (0..120 characters).

questionPreview.description: Truncated preview of the question or form title (0..240 characters).

answerBadge.description: Short answer badge returned to the user (0..48 characters).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the request completed.

UserActiveSession.title: UserActiveSession
UserActiveSession.description: Recorded foreground app or Dynamic Island active duration session for a user. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for endedAt.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user.

userEmail.description: User email for Console visibility (0..254 characters).

source.description: Whether the active time was spent in the main app or floating Dynamic Island.

requestsCount.description: Number of requests raised during this active session.

deviceModel.description: Sanitized Android device model label (0..100 characters).

endedAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the session slice was flushed.

SolvedQuestion.title: SolvedQuestion
SolvedQuestion.description: A solved quiz or study question with structured AI answer badge, concise explanation, subject tag, confidence score, and flashcard bookmark state. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the question owner.

questionText.description: Extracted or typed question text (1..4000 characters).

answerBadge.description: Concise answer badge shown in the floating Dynamic Island (e.g. 'B', 'A, C', 'True', '42.5', '1-C, 2-A').

shortAnswer.description: Short answer phrase shown in Split Pill and Flashcards (0..300 characters).

explanation.description: Concise 2-line step-by-step explanation or formula breakdown (0..2000 characters).

subject.description: Subject domain used for solving and filtering.

language.description: Detected language of the source question (e.g. 'English', 'Hindi', 'Spanish').

translatedQuestion.description: Optional English translation when source question is in another language.

bookmarked.description: Whether the user starred this question for quick study review.

mistakeDeck.description: Whether this item is included in the active Liquid Glass Mistake Flashcard Deck.

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SharedQuizCache.title: SharedQuizCache
SharedQuizCache.description: Immutable verified answer cache entry keyed by canonical 64-char SHA-256 hash of question + options. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt.

questionHash.description: 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 signature of canonical normalized question text + options.

createdByUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the contributor who first verified this answer.

answerBadge.description: Concise winning option badge (e.g. 'B', 'A, C', 'True', or short numeric answer).

shortAnswer.description: Exact wording of winning option or short value (0..300 characters).

explanation.description: Concise 1-sentence reason why the answer is correct (0..500 characters).

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user telemetry dashboard profile showing active time, request counts, average speed, and backend usage.

/users/{userId}/requestLogs/{requestId}.description: Immutable per-user log of every solve request raised across Dynamic Island, Google Forms, Photos, and PDFs.

/users/{userId}/activeSessions/{sessionI.description: Per-user active time sessions recorded from foreground app usage and floating Dynamic Island usage.

/users/{userId}/solvedQuestions/{questio.description: Per-user private collection of solved questions, explanations, bookmarks, and mistake flashcards.

/sharedQuizCache/{questionHash}.description: Global verified question-hash answer cache enabling instant zero-AI-quota hits across users.
